description: The Assistant UI: the persistent badge-bearing trigger in Navigation (desktop sidebar expanded + collapsed, mobile scroll row preserving the onTouchEnd fix), the drawer/bottom-sheet panel with grouping/urgency ordering, dismiss/snooze controls, Tooltip breakdowns for calculated totals, and the component test suite asserting no auto-apply / no character mutation. Also carries the two flagged-ambiguity confirmations and the final full-suite gate. Depends on FEAT-001 (types/engine) and FEAT-002 (provider, dispatchAction, shell wiring).
steps: Create src/components/assistant/AssistantTrigger.tsx (+ .module.css): a single button styled like the Search/Shortcuts triggers, used in three Navigation contexts. Render it in src/components/layout/Navigation.tsx on the desktop expanded sidebar (labelled 'Assistant'), desktop collapsed sidebar (icon-only with aria-label/title via navItemCollapsed), and the mobile mobileScrollRow after Search/Shortcuts using BOTH onClick and onTouchEnd={(e)=>{e.preventDefault(); open();}} (preserve the touch-end fix; the trigger must never call onPageChange). Thread badge count + open through Navigation props. Badge: when >0 render a count with aria-label={`Assistant, ${count} suggestions`} on the button and the number inside a <span aria-hidden>; when 0 show no count but keep the trigger visible/usable. Icon Sparkles or Lightbulb from lucide-react. Do NOT touch badgeItems/badgeDot.

Create src/components/assistant/AssistantPanel.tsx (+ .module.css): one component, two presentations switched on useMediaQuery('(max-width: 767px)') via data-variant='drawer'|'sheet'; createPortal to document.body; returns null when !isOpen; role='dialog' + aria-modal='true' + aria-label='Character Assistant'; focus trap while open; Escape + backdrop close; focus restore to the trigger using the previousFocusRef + requestAnimationFrame pattern from CommandPalette.tsx; render a heading per non-empty category in the ordering groups.

Create src/components/assistant/SuggestionItem.tsx (+ .module.css): renders title, rationale, a primary action <button>, an optional secondary action <button> (corruption 'View Corruption'), the citation from suggestion.citation, and dismiss + snooze <button>s (all keyboard-operable). For each suggestion.totals entry, render via the shared Tooltip + TooltipTriggerCell using the total's lines as the breakdown (hover desktop / tap touch); lines come from the engine, never recomputed in the UI.

If FEAT-002 left a temporary internal panel stub at the App shell, replace it with the real AssistantPanel import; confirm the shell passes suggestions/onAction/onDismiss/onSnooze and the trigger receives count+open.
Create src/components/assistant/__tests__/AssistantPanel.test.tsx and AssistantTrigger.test.tsx (plus SuggestionItem/tooltip coverage) per the design testing strategy.

OQ-2 confirm: implement corruption's strict > as designed AND call send_message (severity 'warning') describing the 1-point edge (rulebook-literal > vs the app's getCorruptionStatus >=) and wait for the answer; if the user picks >=, switch the comparison and the rationale wording in src/logic/assistant/rules/corruption.ts and its test.

OQ-5 confirm: implement the fixed 24h snooze + key 'assistant-dismissals' as designed AND call send_message (severity 'warning') to confirm duration (24h vs 'until next session' vs chooser) and the key/shape; adjust dismissStore.ts only if the user requests a change.

Final gate: run all four verification commands end-to-end and fix anything they surface (including any pre-existing error the change reveals, per fix-errors steering); confirm no new suppressions beyond the single sanctioned set-state-in-effect pattern and that the pre-existing suite is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: A persistent Assistant trigger is visible on desktop (sidebar beside Search/Shortcuts, with collapsed behaviour) and on mobile (mobileScrollRow); its touch handler calls open() and preventDefault (no synthesized-click leak); existing Navigation tests pass.
The trigger shows a badge count equal to suggestions.length when >0, nothing when 0, with the count announced to assistive tech via the button's accessible name.

The panel is closed by default (renders nothing), opens as a drawer (desktop) / bottom sheet (mobile), lists suggestions grouped by category with title/rationale/action, traps focus, closes on Escape/backdrop, and restores focus to the trigger.

A navigate action calls the injected navigate(page,subTab); a roll action opens the seeded RollDialog with the descriptor's difficulty as defaultDifficulty; the corruption item shows BOTH a primary roll and a secondary 'View Corruption' navigate control; NO action mutates a frozen character (spied handlers assert no advance/apply handler is called).
Every calculated total in the panel has a breakdown tooltip via the shared Tooltip/TooltipTriggerCell showing the engine-supplied lines (hover + tap).
Dismissing removes a suggestion and decrements the badge; snoozing suppresses it per policy; both persist locally with no network.
OQ-2 and OQ-5 were flagged to the user via send_message (not silently guessed) and the implementation matches the confirmed choice.
All four gates are clean and the pre-existing suite is unchanged.
verification: vitest --run src/components/assistant (trigger + panel + item tests pass)
vitest --run (full suite green, pre-existing tests unchanged)
npx eslint . (0 errors, no new warnings, no new suppressions beyond the sanctioned set-state-in-effect pattern)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED on current branch (no worktree). All FOUR gates clean: (1) `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` 0 errors; (2) `npm run build` succeeds; (3) `npx vitest --run` 486 files / 5329 tests pass (FEAT-002 baseline was 484/5310 — this FEAT adds 2 test files [AssistantPanel.test.tsx 15 tests, AssistantTrigger.test.tsx 5 tests] and updated the corruption trigger test; +2 files / +19 net tests; pre-existing suite otherwise unchanged); (4) `npx eslint .` 0 errors + the SAME 3 PRE-EXISTING react-refresh/only-export-components warnings only (CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx) — NO new warnings, NO new suppressions (the only set-state-in-effect disables remain the pre-existing ones in Tooltip.tsx / useMediaQuery.ts / App.tsx; none added here).

FILES CREATED:
- src/components/assistant/AssistantTrigger.tsx (+ .module.css) — single button, props { count, open, variant:'desktop'|'collapsed'|'mobile', buttonClassName }. Sparkles icon. Badge: count>0 => aria-label=`Assistant, ${count} suggestions` on the button + the number in a <span aria-hidden>; count===0 => aria-label 'Assistant', no number, trigger still visible/usable. Desktop shows the 'Assistant' text label; collapsed is icon-only with title='Assistant'. Mobile variant adds onTouchEnd={e=>{e.preventDefault();open();}} (the synthesized-click fix) in ADDITION to onClick; desktop/collapsed use onClick only. NEVER calls onPageChange.
- src/components/assistant/SuggestionItem.tsx (+ .module.css) — one row: title, rationale, primary action <button>, optional secondary action <button> (corruption secondary labelled 'View Corruption'; roll actions labelled with test.rollName; other navigates labelled 'Go'), citation (suggestion.citation), and Dismiss + Snooze <button>s. Each suggestion.totals entry renders through the shared Tooltip + TooltipTriggerCell (single-open-at-a-time via local openTotalIndex/anchorEl state) with the total's engine-supplied `lines` as the breakdown — never recomputed in the UI. All controls are real keyboard-operable buttons. No character mutation; only invokes injected onAction/onDismiss/onSnooze.
- src/components/assistant/AssistantPanel.tsx (+ .module.css) — REPLACED the FEAT-002 stub. One component, two presentations via useMediaQuery('(max-width: 767px)') -> data-variant='sheet' (bottom sheet) / 'drawer' (right slide-over). createPortal(document.body); returns null when !isOpen; role='dialog' + aria-modal='true' + aria-label='Character Assistant'. Focus trap (Tab/Shift+Tab) + Escape close + backdrop close (data-testid 'assistant-panel-backdrop'); focus moves to the Close button on open and is restored to the previously-focused trigger on close via previousFocusRef + requestAnimationFrame (CommandPalette pattern). Renders a <h3> heading per NON-EMPTY category group, preserving the engine's ordering (groupByCategory walks the already-ordered list; CATEGORY_LABELS supplies display labels only, never reorders). Empty state 'No suggestions right now.'.
- src/components/assistant/__tests__/AssistantTrigger.test.tsx (5) + AssistantPanel.test.tsx (15, incl. SuggestionItem + tooltip coverage).

FEAT-002 STUB REPLACED: yes. src/components/assistant/AssistantPanel.tsx is now the real panel; AssistantPanelProps shape ({ suggestions, onAction, onDismiss, onSnooze }) is UNCHANGED, so the App.tsx mount point and FEAT-002 wiring needed no edits. Confirmed App.tsx already passes suggestions/onAction=dispatchAction/onDismiss=handleDismissSuggestion/onSnooze=handleSnoozeSuggestion and the Navigation trigger receives assistantCount={suggestions.length} + onOpenAssistant={openAssistant}.

NAVIGATION WIRING: src/components/layout/Navigation.tsx now imports AssistantTrigger, destructures the FEAT-002-declared assistantCount/onOpenAssistant props, and renders <AssistantTrigger> in THREE contexts — (a) mobile mobileScrollRow AFTER the Search and Shortcuts buttons (variant='mobile', buttonClassName=styles.navItem), (b) desktop expanded sidebar (variant='desktop') and (c) desktop collapsed sidebar (variant='collapsed', buttonClassName=`${styles.navItem} ${styles.navItemCollapsed}`), rendered just before the desktop Keyboard-Shortcuts affordance. All three gated on `onOpenAssistant &&`. The existing handleNavTouchEnd preventDefault fix for NAV_ITEMS is PRESERVED untouched; badgeItems/badgeDot were NOT modified.

OQ-2 (corruption > vs >=): FLAGGED to the user via send_message(severity 'warning') describing strict > (as-implemented) vs >= (at-or-over) and the 1-point edge. USER CHOSE `>=`. Changed src/logic/assistant/rules/corruption.ts from `!(corr > threshold)` to `!(corr >= threshold)` and reworded the rationale to 'Your Corruption is at or above your Corruption threshold (TB + WPB + Pure Soul) — attempt a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test to resist corrupting (Core p.183).' (deliberately AVOIDS quoting RAW 'more than' per the user's rules-compliance note; Pure Soul kept in the threshold via getCorruptionThreshold(chars, getPureSoulLevel(talents))). Rationale: match the app's own getCorruptionStatus 'danger' band (src/logic/corruption.ts uses corr >= threshold) so the assistant fires exactly when the Corruption panel turns red — no at-threshold mismatch. Citation unchanged: 'Core p.183: Corrupting (+ Pure Soul talent, p.182)'. Updated the corruption trigger test in src/logic/assistant/__tests__/engine.test.ts to assert >= semantics (below=none, at=due, over=due) and reworded the Pure-Soul test comment.
- OQ-5 (snooze duration/key): FLAGGED to the user via send_message(severity 'warning') describing the as-implemented fixed 24h + key 'assistant-dismissals' and the alternatives (different duration, 'until next session', chooser, different key/shape). USER CHOSE: keep exactly as implemented. NO change to dismissStore.ts.

TEST NOTES: matchMedia defaults to {matches:false} in test-setup.ts, so AssistantPanel renders the 'drawer' variant under test (asserted). AssistantPanel tests assert: closed=>no dialog; open=>role=dialog aria-modal=true grouped by category headings; navigate action => onAction(navigate descriptor); roll action => onAction(roll descriptor w/ difficulty); corruption shows BOTH primary roll + secondary 'View Corruption'; citation rendered; calculated total 'Corruption 7 / 6' breakdown tooltip reveals engine-supplied lines (TB 3 / WPB 3 / Pure Soul 0); Dismiss/Snooze call handlers with the id; Escape/backdrop/close-button all close; and a 'no mutation' assertion confirming the panel exposes ONLY onAction/onDismiss/onSnooze (no apply/advance prop) and invoking every control hits only those callbacks. AssistantTrigger tests assert count badge aria behaviour, collapsed icon-only, and onTouchEnd preventDefault (fireEvent.touchEnd returns false) + open().
